messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD alert (11:03 UTC): api-gateway cluster reports surge in 429s followed by elevated 5xx (502/504) and increased timeouts. Paging @hanako.yamada. alert: https://alert.example/ALERT-9021
hanako.yamada: taking pager. first glance: 429s spike at 10:58, then backend pools returning 502s. looks like quota scopes were flattened during today's policy roll. grabbing traces and sampling request headers.
mike: i see a job `quota-merge` ran at 10:56 that combined overlap rules. job log shows `template_expand()` returned empty scope_id for ~2k rules. possible templater bug.
devops-bot: Deploy event: quota-merges v2.11 -> production at 10:56 by rachel. Rollout ID: rollout-2026-03-15-1056.
rachel: confirmed i kicked off the merge; it was intended to dedupe rules but there was a fallback path that defaulted to GLOBAL_SCOPE when scope_id missing. starting rollback now.
oncall-sre: hold on mitigation: if we just rollback, clients may still be retrying aggressively. we should short-circuit client retries at the edge and add a temporary `Retry-After` header to encourage backoff.
hanako.yamada: good call. can we patch the gateway to return `429` with `Retry-After` and disable our internal automatic retries to avoid thundering herd?
devops-bot: Patching gateway hot: `gwctl set-retry-policy --max-retries=0 --inject-header="Retry-After: 10" --scope=temp` (applied to prod-edge-*/clusters).
mike: rollback of quota-merge initiated: `deploy rollback quota-merge --to=2026-03-14-2230`. reverting templater change.
ton.k: clients with aggressive retry libs already triggered a retry storm; i recommend adding exemptions for high-SLA tenants and temporarily routing them to a read-only fallback if possible.
cs-ops: listing impacted customers: Hyperlane, NovaPay, FluxRetail. CS notified and opening support tickets; offering 2 days of credits for affected requests.
hanako.yamada: added emergency exemptions for top-tenants at the auth layer: `authctl exempt --tenant=HYPERLANE --ttl=40m` and same for NOVAPAY/FLUX. exemptions applied to 5/5 auth nodes.
mike: rollback complete; policy manifests show per-tenant buckets restored. however connections backlog on gateway nodes remains: high `syn-ack` queues, many sockets in TIME_WAIT, accept queue saturation.
oncall-sre: starting graceful rolling restart of gateway pods to clear stuck connections: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/gateway -n prod --grace-period=60`
rachel: also toggling circuit-breaker to fail-fast for overloaded upstreams so we avoid long waits: `upstreamctl set-circuit --service=backend-pool --open-ms=200 --consecutive-errors=5`
devops-bot: circuit-breaker change applied.
hanako.yamada: after exemptions + rollback + restarts + circuit-breaker, error rates dropping: 429s down ~90% from peak, 5xx trending to baseline but some regions still show lag due to propagation.
ton.k: added ephemeral-port tuning on nodes as a hotfix: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range='15000 61000'` and `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1`. also reduced `tcp_fin_timeout` to 30s.
mike: root cause: templater bug that silently substituted GLOBAL_SCOPE when scope_id missing combined with a canary gate being skipped for quota-merges. follow-ups: add template schema validation, require explicit scope IDs, and add a mandatory canary window for policy merges.
oncall-sre: incident severity -> monitoring. moving to post-incident coordination. please keep 1m dashboards for 90 minutes.
cs-ops: CS follow-ups in flight. account teams have been sent impact lists and temp credits applied.
hanako.yamada: owners for postmortem: mike (root cause & fix), rachel (deployment process), hanako (mitigation timeline + runbook updates), oncall-sre (infra tuning recommendations). i'll draft timeline and attach logs/traces.
mike: opened PRs: 1) `templater:strict-scope-validation` https://git.example/templater/pull/247 2) `quota-merge:require-canary` https://git.example/quota-merge/pull/88. adding CI lint to catch GLOBAL_SCOPE regressions.
rachel: will add a deploy blocker so quota-merge cannot roll out without manual ack after midnight UTC.
oncall-sre: summary of mitigations applied: rollback quota merge, emergency tenant exemptions, disable internal retries + inject Retry-After, circuit-breaker tuning, rolling restart of gateways, TCP stack tuning.
hanako.yamada: leaving emergency exemptions for 30m then will remove; monitoring open for 2 hours. incident doc created: https://incidents.example/3410002222. thanks team for quick response. :thumbsup:
cs-ops: scheduling customer check-ins for affected accounts.
mike: note for postmortem: we should consider rate-policy canary traffic split and synthetic load tests to validate no-scope regressions.
hanako.yamada: incident mitigated. switching pager to standby. will follow up with a blameless postmortem and runbook updates tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
